title: Quad expands cooperation on AI, critical minerals and maritime security
script:
Four nations just signed a major pact for tech cooperation.
India, the United States, Japan, and Australia are leading the initiative.
The agreement targets joint research on AI and critical minerals.
Officials designed the framework to secure supply chains across the Indo Pacific region.
Maritime security cooperation is also a core focus of the new deal.
Will this alliance effectively counter emerging technology monopolies?
